breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a more detailed 'Deterministic IMEX' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified the IMEX scheme as the intended, more detailed method and its generated specification only describes the steps for the IMEX update, completely and correctly ignoring the conflicting instruction.
